About me

Design, development and curiosity

I'm Juliana Gonzalez, a Web Developer whose journey began in graphic design and evolved into creating digital experiences.

My approach

I combine front-end implementation, visual awareness and problem solving to turn requirements and designs into clear, functional web experiences.

Why I created Julitree

Julitree has been my creative identity for years. The name combines something personal with the idea of growing, putting down roots and developing new branches of knowledge.

I created this space to share what I learn about web development and artificial intelligence. I do not claim to have every answer. I want to understand the tools we use more deeply, test them with care and explain their concepts in an approachable way.

I currently work on web interface and portal implementation, collaborating with UX, QA and development teams. Artificial intelligence has become a new branch of learning that I want to explore without separating technology from human responsibility.
